sentence: This project studies how a mother's smartphone use affects her emotional well-being, her caregiving quality and the socioemotional development of her infant.
This project keeps brain tissue samples and studies them after death to confirm Alzheimer's disease and related disorders.
This project studies how mitochondrial dysfunction leads offspring of older mothers to age faster and have a shorter lifespan.
This project studies how personality disorder develops over time and shows up in daily life in young people.
This project tests a technology that detects tumor DNA in cerebrospinal fluid to help diagnose brain cancers.
This project studies how mitochondrial metabolism controls the speed of embryonic development in mouse and human models.
This project tests whether an enzyme that makes fatty acids helps lung cancer cells survive by blocking ferroptosis, a form of cell death.
This project keeps a repository of biospecimens to help understand the clinical, biologic and genetic basis of prostate cancer.
This project builds virtual world software for a headset that tracks the hands so people can practice daily activities during stroke rehabilitation.
This project studies how a signaling pathway helps a fusion sarcoma spread and suppress the immune system.
This project studies how changes to a type of RNA and the enzymes that alter it affect melanoma and its spread.
This project studies how coronaviruses interact with human and bat cells and how the cells respond, using proteomics, transcriptomics and modeling.
This project builds a research program with communities in areas of persistent poverty to improve cancer prevention and control.
This project studies how factors made by the liver help maintain red blood cell production in the bone marrow.
This project studies how exposure to chemical warfare vesicants changes metabolism and whether glutamine metabolism protects tissue.
This project studies how epigenetic changes during withdrawal from chronic alcohol drinking in rats alter neuroimmune gene expression and neuronal function in the hippocampus.
This project studies how a fusion improves T cell fitness and anti-tumor efficacy.
This project finds proteins that bind a type of DNA methylation in neurons and studies how they control genes in the adult mouse brain.
